catalog.applicability: Successfully fetched in-scope page with an HTTP status; violation requires explicit redirect prohibition
catalog.explanation: A redirect is an observation and may be intentional.
catalog.fix_guidance: Review the redirect only when it conflicts with the intended URL policy.

catalog.applicability: Successfully extracted HTML with a nonempty title
catalog.explanation: Character count crosses a configured review threshold; display depends on context and there is no universal ideal length.
catalog.fix_guidance: Review whether the title describes the page clearly; edit only where useful.

catalog.applicability: Successfully extracted HTML with a nonempty title
catalog.explanation: Character count crosses a configured review threshold; display depends on context and there is no universal ideal length.
catalog.fix_guidance: Review whether the title describes the page clearly; edit only where useful.

catalog.applicability: Successfully extracted HTML with a nonempty description
catalog.explanation: Character count crosses a configured review threshold; search snippets vary by query and display.
catalog.fix_guidance: Review whether the description accurately summarizes the page.

catalog.applicability: Successfully extracted HTML with a nonempty description
catalog.explanation: Character count crosses a configured review threshold; search snippets vary by query and display.
catalog.fix_guidance: Review whether the description accurately summarizes the page.

catalog.applicability: Successfully fetched in-scope HTML page; violation requires explicit indexability intent
catalog.explanation: A noindex directive is an observation and may be intentional.
catalog.fix_guidance: If this page should be indexed, review its robots directives.

catalog.explanation: Extracted word count falls below a configured review threshold; word count alone does not determine content quality.
catalog.fix_guidance: Assess whether the page answers its users' needs; do not add words solely to meet a count.

catalog.explanation: Outgoing link count exceeds a configured review threshold; this is not a universal link limit.
catalog.fix_guidance: Review whether links are useful, contextual and crawlable.

catalog.explanation: Observed alternate collection; an empty collection is not a defect.
catalog.fix_guidance: Review alternate language references when relevant.

catalog.applicability: External target recorded as a page
catalog.explanation: A fetch status is an observation; unavailable is unknown.
catalog.fix_guidance: Inspect the target only when the status conflicts with its intended destination.

catalog.applicability: External link from an in-scope page
catalog.explanation: A referenced target may be unavailable or outside the crawl; this is not a defect by itself.
catalog.evidence_schema: page.links and target status when fetched
catalog.fix_guidance: Inspect the link in context if its destination needs review.
